api/account:
GET /account

Returns the signed-in customer's account record as JSON.

Response fields

  • id — an opaque account id (string).
  • owner — the account holder's name (string).
  • balance — the account balance as an integer number of minor units (cents) of currency. For example 10000 means 100.00.
  • currency — the ISO 4217 currency code (string).

All four fields — id, owner, balance, and currency — are required. A balance is meaningless without its currency.
guide/contract:
The contract

The Storefront API is described by an OpenAPI 3.1 document (openapi.json). Every response must match the schema declared for its path and status. Omitting a required field is a contract violation even when a forgiving client happens to render the page anyway — the breach is invisible to the UI but real to every other consumer of the API.
guide/currency:
Currency

Every account carries a currency (an ISO 4217 code such as EUR or USD), and it is a required field on GET /account. A monetary balance is meaningless without it: 10000 is 100.00 euros or 100.00 dollars depending entirely on this field. When currency is missing, downstream consumers do not error — they quietly assume USD, so a EUR balance is billed, displayed, and converted as if it were dollars. That is silent data loss, which is why the contract pins currency as required.
